title: Ditshingwana tse di Nyelang tsa Katlego
intro: Mo lefatsheng le le segofaditsweng ka letlotlo le legolo, morafe o ne wa atlega, o tshela mo gare ga matshwao a tshegofatso ya bomodimo. Katlego ya bone e ne e le bosupi jwa gore Morena wa bone o ba amogela, mpho e e neng e diretswe go tlhotlheletsa tebogo le kutlo. Mme lefa go ntse jalo, go sa kgathalesege ditshupo tse di bonalang sentle tsa masego a bone, go ne ga tla phetogo e e neng ya gwetlha tsela e ba neng ba anaanela motswedi wa khumo ya bone e e seng kana ka sepe le kgomotso ka yone.
clues: Re ne ra segofadiwa ka ditshingwana tse pedi, e nngwe e le kafa mojeng mme e nngwe e le kafa molemeng, e e nang le dijalo tse dintsi.
Re ne re laetswe go ja mo tlamelong ya Morena wa rona le go mo lebogela lefatshe le le molemo le Morena yo o itshwarelang.
Re ne ra nna mabela mme ra fapoga tsela ya go leboga, re ipelafatsa ka khumo le maatla a rona.
Re ne re batla gore Morena wa rona a oketse sekgala fa gare ga maeto a rona, re bontsha go nyatsa bonolo jo a bo re neileng.
Re ne ra tlhagisiwa ke morongwa, mme re ne ra gana molaetsa mme ra tswelela ka go tlhoka tlhokomelo ga rona.
Letamo la rona le legolo, le le neng le tshegetsa katlego ya rona, kgabagare le ne la thubega, mme la baka morwalela o o senyang.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Tlhaselo ya mophato o o nonofileng
Thoromo ya lefatshe e e senyang
Morwalela o o senyang o o tswang mo letamong le le thubegileng
Go gatelelwa ke mmusi yo o bogateledi
trial.answer: Morwalela o o senyang o o tswang mo letamong le le thubegileng

outcome.label: Botso
options: Re ne ra fetolwa go nna ditshwene le dikolobe
Re ne ra bolokwa mme ra fudugela kwa lefatsheng le lesha
Re ne ra phatlalala mme naga ya rona ya nna moopa
Re agile bogosi jo bosha, jo bo atlegileng thata
outcome.answer: Re ne ra phatlalala mme naga ya rona ya nna moopa

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
